def new_ref

  Result ((Array Std.U8 32#usize) × H)
  := do

  (state : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (row : Std.U8) (payload : Slice Std.U8) :

import Aeneas.Std
/-! The retained sampler uses only this array lemma from the unrelated
mask-Horner proof cone. Copy the identical small API proof to avoid importing
or rebuilding that unrelated cone. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDH_ArrayIndex
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem array_index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Aeneas.Std.Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize a i =
      .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]
#print axioms array_index_usize_ok
end NDH_ArrayIndex

import R1Merkle32Leaf
import NDH_ArrayIndex
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDH_MerkleGrammar
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1

def byte (x : U8) : Fin 256 := ⟨x.val,x.bv.isLt⟩

def row (c : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) (i : Fin 8) : Array U8 32#usize :=
  c.val[i.val]'(by have := c.property; change c.val.length=8 at this; omega)

def children (c : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) : Merkle32Path.Children :=
  fun i j => byte ((row c i).val[j.val]'(by
    have h := (row c i).property
    change (row c i).val.length=32 at h
    omega))

theorem row_ofFn (a : Array U8 32#usize) :
    a.val.map byte = List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 32 =>
      byte (a.val[j.val]'(by have := a.property; change a.val.length=32 at this; omega))) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_map,List.length_ofFn]
    exact a.property
  · intro i hi hj
    simp only [List.getElem_map,List.getElem_ofFn]

theorem chunks (c : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) :
    (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 => (row c i).val.map byte)).flatten =
      Merkle32Path.nodeBytes (children c) := by
  unfold Merkle32Path.nodeBytes
  rw [List.ofFn_mul (m:=8) (n:=32)]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  rw [row_ofFn]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext j
  have hd : (i.val*32+j.val)/32=i.val := by omega
  have hm : (i.val*32+j.val)%32=j.val := by omega
  simp only [Merkle32Path.childByte, children, hd, hm]

def sourceNode (c : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) : List (Fin 256) :=
  24 :: (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 => (row c i).val.map byte)).flatten

theorem node (c : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) :
    sourceNode c = Merkle32Path.nodeInput (children c) := by
  unfold sourceNode Merkle32Path.nodeInput
  rw [chunks]

#print axioms row_ofFn
#print axioms chunks
#print axioms node
end NDH_MerkleGrammar

import NDH_TranscriptReference.Funs
import NDH_MerkleGrammar
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDH_HashBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1 NDH_MerkleGrammar

def input (parts : Slice (Slice U8)) : List (Fin 256) :=
  parts.val.flatMap (fun part => part.val.map byte)

/-- The handler interpretation is the retained runtime sha256=H realization.
It is not a new hash-value proof or a supplied caller-output equality. -/
theorem leaf {H : Type} (D : NDH_TranscriptReference.NDH_DigestRef H) (hash : H)
    (oracle : List (Fin 256) → Result (Array U8 32#usize))
    (physical : ∀ parts, D.digest hash parts = oracle (input parts))
    (tag : U8) (value : Slice U8) (salt : Array U8 32#usize) :
    NDH_TranscriptReference.leaf_ref D hash tag value salt =
      oracle (Merkle32Leaf.leafInput (byte tag) (value.val.map byte) (salt.val.map byte)) := by
  simp only [NDH_TranscriptReference.leaf_ref,lift,bind_tc_ok,physical]
  change oracle (([byte 16#u8,byte tag] ++ (value.val.map byte ++ (salt.val.map byte ++ [])))) = _
  simp only [List.append_nil,Merkle32Leaf.leafInput]
  rfl

theorem parent {H : Type} (D : NDH_TranscriptReference.NDH_DigestRef H) (hash : H)
    (oracle : List (Fin 256) → Result (Array U8 32#usize))
    (physical : ∀ parts, D.digest hash parts = oracle (input parts))
    (c : Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize) :
    NDH_TranscriptReference.parent_ref D hash c =
      oracle (Merkle32Path.nodeInput (children c)) := by
  have i0 : Array.index_usize c 0#usize = ok (row c 0) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 0#usize (by decide)
  have i1 : Array.index_usize c 1#usize = ok (row c 1) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 1#usize (by decide)
  have i2 : Array.index_usize c 2#usize = ok (row c 2) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 2#usize (by decide)
  have i3 : Array.index_usize c 3#usize = ok (row c 3) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 3#usize (by decide)
  have i4 : Array.index_usize c 4#usize = ok (row c 4) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 4#usize (by decide)
  have i5 : Array.index_usize c 5#usize = ok (row c 5) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 5#usize (by decide)
  have i6 : Array.index_usize c 6#usize = ok (row c 6) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 6#usize (by decide)
  have i7 : Array.index_usize c 7#usize = ok (row c 7) := by
    simpa [row] using NDH_ArrayIndex.array_index_usize_ok c 7#usize (by decide)
  simp only [NDH_TranscriptReference.parent_ref,i0,i1,i2,i3,i4,i5,i6,i7,lift,bind_tc_ok,physical]
  rw [←NDH_MerkleGrammar.node c]
  all_goals rfl

#print axioms leaf
#print axioms parent
end NDH_HashBridge

import Port4B_Bounds

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBE_BatchDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

/-- Both actual transaction splits, without restricting the second to ten. -/
theorem split_domain (batch : Usize) :
    0 < (Port4B_TreeCuts.count batch).val ∧
    (Port4B_TreeCuts.count batch).val ≤ 16 ∧
    (Port4B_TreeCuts.lo batch).val + (Port4B_TreeCuts.count batch).val = 22 ∨
    (Port4B_TreeCuts.lo batch).val = 0 ∧
    (Port4B_TreeCuts.count batch).val = 10 := by
  obtain ⟨hc,hl⟩ := Port4B_Bounds.count batch
  by_cases zero : batch = 0#usize
  · right
    subst batch
    exact ⟨hl, hc⟩
  · left
    have nz : batch.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      exact zero (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h)
    rw [if_neg zero] at hc
    rw [if_neg nz] at hl
    omega

/-- Every actual key iteration reads an existing query and writes a live
scratch cell; rebased low-byte positions stay in the same batch. -/
theorem key_domain (batch : Usize) (j : Nat)
    (active : j < (Port4B_TreeCuts.count batch).val) :
    j < 16 ∧ j < 256 ∧ (Port4B_TreeCuts.lo batch).val + j < 22 := by
  obtain ⟨hc,hl⟩ := Port4B_Bounds.count batch
  by_cases zero : batch = 0#usize
  · subst batch
    simp only [show (0#usize).val = 0 from rfl, ite_true] at hc hl
    omega
  · have nz : batch.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      exact zero (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h)
    rw [if_neg zero] at hc
    rw [if_neg nz] at hl
    omega

/-- The slot selected by either caller is one of the six physical slots. -/
theorem slot_domain (batch tree : Usize) (hb : batch.val < 2)
    (ht : tree.val < 3) :
    (Port4B_TreeCuts.slot batch tree).val = 3*batch.val + tree.val ∧
    (Port4B_TreeCuts.slot batch tree).val < 6 := by
  have h := Port4B_Bounds.slot batch tree hb ht
  exact ⟨h, by rw [h]; omega⟩

#print axioms split_domain
#print axioms key_domain
#print axioms slot_domain
end AspisR1.NBE_BatchDomains

NBE_KeyLoop.content:
import NBE_BatchDomains

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBE_KeyLoop

/-- Pointwise denotation of the single native key-array write. The arbitrary
coordinate frame is checked by NBE_key; no whole-loop equality is assumed. -/
def write {α : Type} (word state : Nat → α) (cursor : Nat) : Nat → α :=
  fun k => if k = cursor then word cursor else state k

/-- Forward source order: update this cell, then advance the cursor. -/
def fill {α : Type} (word : Nat → α) : Nat → Nat → (Nat → α) → (Nat → α)
  | 0, _, state => state
  | fuel+1, cursor, state => fill word fuel (cursor+1) (write word state cursor)

/-- All coordinates, including the entire untouched suffix. -/
theorem fill_values {α : Type} (word initial : Nat → α) (fuel cursor k : Nat) :
    fill word fuel cursor initial k =
      if cursor ≤ k ∧ k < cursor+fuel then word k else initial k := by
  induction fuel generalizing cursor initial with
  | zero => simp [fill]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [fill, ih]
    by_cases hit : k = cursor
    · subst k
      rw [if_neg (by omega), write, if_pos rfl, if_pos (by omega)]
    · by_cases later : cursor+1 ≤ k ∧ k < cursor+1+fuel
      · rw [if_pos later, if_pos (by omega)]
      · rw [if_neg later, write, if_neg hit, if_neg (by omega)]

/-- Each reached induction step satisfies the same bounds as the native
one-iteration gate, derived from the actual split, for BOTH transactions. -/
theorem reached_domain (batch : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (cursor : Nat)
    (active : cursor < (Port4B_TreeCuts.count batch).val) :
    cursor < 16 ∧ cursor < 256 ∧
    (Port4B_TreeCuts.lo batch).val + cursor < 22 :=
  NBE_BatchDomains.key_domain batch cursor active

#print axioms fill_values
#print axioms reached_domain
end AspisR1.NBE_KeyLoop

NBI_Keys.content:
import NBE_KeyLoop
import Port4B_KeyInstall
import Port4B_Opening

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBI_Keys
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open OraclePortSelectedDraft MultiproofConeSortOrder

/-- No modulo weakening: every selected canonical raw word is identical to
its installed finite query. This domain must be derived by the producer. -/
theorem canonical_query (raw : Array U32 22#usize) (j : Nat) (jb : j < 22)
    (canonical : raw.val[j]!.val < 262144) :
    (Port4B_KeyInstall.queries raw ⟨j,jb⟩).val = raw.val[j]!.val := by
  have len : raw.val.length = 22 := raw.property
  have h : j < raw.val.length := by omega
  simp only [Port4B_KeyInstall.queries,List.getElem?_map,List.getElem?_eq_getElem h,
    Option.map_some,Option.getD_some]
  simpa only [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_eq_getElem h,Option.getD_some]
    using Nat.mod_eq_of_lt canonical

/-- The natural word checked by NBE_key is exactly the installed packed U64
word for both transaction splits, before any sorting is considered. -/
theorem packed_word (raw : Array U32 22#usize) (batch kind j : Nat)
    (jb : j < (if batch = 0 then 10 else 12))
    (canonical : raw.val[(if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j]!.val < 262144) :
    (packed (Port4B_KeyInstall.queries raw) batch kind
      ((if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j)).val =
      256 * (if kind = 2 then raw.val[(if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j]!.val / 4
        else raw.val[(if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j]!.val) + j := by
  have pos : (if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j < 22 := by by_cases h : batch = 0 <;> simp_all <;> omega
  have query := canonical_query raw ((if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j) pos canonical
  simp only [packed,index,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt pos,query]
  simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt pos]

/-- List form of the native zero-initialized suffix. -/
theorem padded_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (front : List α) (zero : α)
    (bound : front.length ≤ 16) (k : Nat) (kb : k < 16) :
    (front ++ List.replicate (16-front.length) zero)[k]! =
      if k < front.length then front[k]! else zero := by
  by_cases active : k < front.length
  · simp only [if_pos active,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_append_left active]
  · rw [if_neg active,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
    simp only [List.getElem?_replicate,if_pos (by omega : k-front.length < 16-front.length),Option.getD_some]

/-- Exact forward producer, including every untouched zero suffix coordinate.
The word is the native step's packed word, not an assumed final array. -/
theorem key_array_values (raw : Array U32 22#usize) (batch kind k : Nat) (kb : k < 16) :
    NBE_KeyLoop.fill
      (fun j => packed (Port4B_KeyInstall.queries raw) batch kind
        ((if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j))
      (if batch = 0 then 10 else 12) 0 (fun _ => 0#u64) k =
      (Port4B_KeyInstall.keyArray raw batch kind).val[k]! := by
  rw [NBE_KeyLoop.fill_values]
  change _ = ((Port4B_KeyInstall.prefixKeys raw batch kind) ++
    List.replicate (16-(Port4B_KeyInstall.prefixKeys raw batch kind).length) 0#u64)[k]!
  rw [padded_get _ _ (Port4B_KeyInstall.prefix_bound raw batch kind) k kb]
  by_cases zero : batch = 0
  · subst batch
    by_cases active : k < 10 <;>
      simp [Port4B_KeyInstall.prefixKeys,batchPositions,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,active]
  · by_cases active : k < 12 <;>
      simp [Port4B_KeyInstall.prefixKeys,batchPositions,zero,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,Nat.add_comm,active]

/-- Array constructed by the forward native single-write recurrence. -/
def producer (raw : Array U32 22#usize) (batch kind : Nat) : Array U64 16#usize :=
  ⟨List.ofFn (fun k : Fin 16 => NBE_KeyLoop.fill
    (fun j => packed (Port4B_KeyInstall.queries raw) batch kind
      ((if batch = 0 then 0 else 10)+j))
    (if batch = 0 then 10 else 12) 0 (fun _ => 0#u64) k.val),by simp⟩

/-- Forward step induction yields the complete installed array, with no final
array equation or final-coordinate observations supplied as premises. -/
theorem producer_eq (raw : Array U32 22#usize) (batch kind : Nat) :
    producer raw batch kind = Port4B_KeyInstall.keyArray raw batch kind := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · exact (producer raw batch kind).property.trans
      (Port4B_KeyInstall.keyArray raw batch kind).property.symm
  · intro k ha hb
    have kb : k < 16 := by simpa only [producer,List.length_ofFn] using ha
    have cells := key_array_values raw batch kind k kb
    simpa only [producer,List.getElem_ofFn,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb,Option.getD_some] using cells

#print axioms canonical_query
#print axioms packed_word
#print axioms padded_get
#print axioms key_array_values
#print axioms producer_eq
end AspisR1.NBI_Keys

NBI_Sort.content:
import NBI_Keys
import MultiproofConeSortStep
import Port4B_SortInstall

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBI_Sort
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result MultiproofSortRef
open MultiproofConeSortStep

/-- Natural carrier of NBE's ONE native swap/stop check. No sorted output
or whole-sort equation is included in the observation. -/
def NativeStep (keys : Array U64 16#usize) (cursor : Usize) :
    sort_reference.InsertStep → Prop
  | .Done out => out = keys ∧ (cursor.val = 0 ∨
      keys.val[cursor.val-1]!.val ≤ keys.val[cursor.val]!.val)
  | .Next out lower => lower.val+1 = cursor.val ∧
      keys.val[lower.val]!.val > keys.val[cursor.val]!.val ∧
      out = (keys.set lower keys.val[cursor.val]!).set cursor keys.val[lower.val]!

/-- Single-step natural comparisons have the same meaning on the installed
U64 carrier; no modulo, truncated comparison or tie-order change is added. -/
theorem natural_post (keys : Array U64 16#usize) (cursor : Usize)
    (out : sort_reference.InsertStep) : NativeStep keys cursor out ↔ StepPost keys cursor out := by
  cases out <;> rfl

/-- A deterministic one-step observation uniquely selects the installed
step, including the zero cursor and equal-key stop cases. -/
theorem step_port (keys : Array U64 16#usize) (cursor : Usize) (bound : cursor.val < 16)
    (observed : sort_reference.InsertStep) (native : NativeStep keys cursor observed) :
    sort_reference.insert_step keys cursor = ok observed := by
  obtain ⟨actual,returned,post⟩ := insert_step_total keys cursor bound
  have obs := (natural_post keys cursor observed).mp native
  suffices actual = observed by simpa only [this] using returned
  cases actual with
  | Done out =>
    rcases post with ⟨rfl,stop⟩
    cases observed with
    | Done other => exact congrArg sort_reference.InsertStep.Done obs.1.symm
    | Next other lower =>
      rcases obs with ⟨lv,greater,eq⟩
      have same : lower.val = cursor.val-1 := by omega
      rcases stop with zero|le
      · omega
      · rw [same] at greater
        exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge le greater)
  | Next out lower =>
    rcases post with ⟨lv,greater,rfl⟩
    cases observed with
    | Done other =>
      rcases obs.2 with zero|le
      · omega
      · have same : lower.val = cursor.val-1 := by omega
        rw [same] at greater
        exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge le greater)
    | Next other otherLower =>
      rcases obs with ⟨ov,_,rfl⟩
      have same : lower = otherLower := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by omega)
      subst otherLower
      rfl

end AspisR1.NBI_Sort
